notes.title: Dedicated servers closing down after 4 years.
notes.content:
Since the full Bannermen release in February 2019, we have offered players across the globe the possibility to find matches and create custom games with friends using our dedicated servers.

However, due to low server activity and the fact that Amazon Web Services is discontinuing their software framework support for the version Bannermen utilizes, all dedicated Bannermen servers will be closed down by the end of June, 2023, i.e. in about 8 weeks from now. We will soon update the store page with relevant info.

The singleplayer part of Bannermen will still be available, and all saves will remain unchanged. You can still enjoy AI skirmishes and enter the role as Lord Berrian in the campaign, and become the savior of Valtoria.

notes.title: Content update on friday!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026079/ad3722fcb2cd0ccd948791e381e5b273b437502c.png[/img]

[h1][b]Get ready for the weekend![/b][/h1]
Patch 1.1.0 is coming [b]April 5th![/b]

[b]What's in the update?[/b]
[list][*] New King's Court unit, [b]Vanguard[/b].
[*] New Workshop unit, [b]Ballista[/b].
[*] New 2vs2 map available in Skirmish and multiplayer
[*] Bug fixes, primarily concerning hotkey bindings.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026079/ea471acdbcbf329a3d764bb952eb832db7196c89.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Ballista[/b][/h1]
[i][b]The ballista is used to take down units at great distance from the rear.[/b][/i]

A heavy range unit with unbeatable attack range. The Ballista has a special ability (which needs to be activated manually on an enemy unit) that fires away an arrow missile with a chain attached to the Ballista. When the enemy unit has been hit, the Ballista pulls the unit close. This ability can be very useful against heavy armored range enemies, such as Catapults. Ballistas are produced in the Workshop building.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026079/4b4bbd2940c2aee51243b0b6adf9ede7c5080f9d.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Vanguard[/b][/h1]
[i][b]The vanguard is the leading part of an advancing military formation.[/b][/i]

A melee unit with great attack range thanks to his long halberd. His standard attack does not only deal decent damage, it also pushes the targeted enemy unit away from the Vanguard. Vanguards are especially useful against heavy melee units, such as Knights. Vanguards are produced in the King's Court building.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026079/4444f63c74f757da7149dff6aacaddec16ccceff.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
Now you can send emoticons through the chat and bind it to your desired key. As of now you might have to reset your options for the new keybind to work. 

We have chosen to give a slight nerf to Lord Berrian and made Lord Karthor's ultimate ability a little easier to cast. Tell us what you think of these changes, please.

[h1][b]Patch notes[/b][/h1]
[b]Major[/b]
- Fixed MMR not being updated.
- We now support names with special characters.
- Fixed crash report window from opening when exiting the game.

[b]Minor[/b]
- Added emoticons to chat (write :bm: for example). All emoticons from Bannermen’s Discord except froggy is available.
- Added a keybinding (default Y) for chat. Reset your options before binding it.
- Fixed translations on tutorial map.
- Made Vanya contribute more to winning on the Fall of a Traitor mission.

[b]Balance[/b]
- Lord Berrian, Grand Slam (R), range decreased from 600 -> 500
- Lord Karthor, Demonic Roar (R), range increased from 650 -> 800
- Lord karthor, Demonic Roar (R), cast time reduced from 1 000 - 800

notes.title: Bannermen release date & campaign trailer
notes.content:
[b][h1]Bannermen releases February 21, 2019[/h1][/b]
To celebrate our progress we have also released our campaign trailer to get you in the mood for the journey ahead! Enough with the jolly times, it is time for you to redeem yourself as Lord Berrian and take control of the raging war that has plagued Valtoria for long enough.

[h1][b]Bannermen Campaign Trailer (YouTube)[/b][/h1]
[url=https://youtu.be/3YD6K_-QlNk][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026079/4f23f7a73483fd27035e311a4806f5056615b782.jpg[/img][/url]

The people of Valtoria have waited and so have you and now is not the time to get cold feet with only another month remaining!

While you wait you can share your enthusiasm with like-minded people in our Discord. If you like RTS games you will feel right at home and maybe learn a thing or two about Bannermen and get your opinions heard by the developers.

[url=Discord.gg/Bannermen][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026079/dd243fd400abbaf1acef9f4d7ba89a7e121fbc70.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Playtesting[/b]
Shortly before the full release, we will arrange a beta. More info regarding this (dates, content, etc.) will be announced soon. If you haven't already, make sure you sign up on the Bannermen website to secure a beta key!
[b][url=https://bannermen.net]Bannermen.net[/url][/b]

Like no one ever was...[/i][/b]

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026079/dcdbaf0b51d19bb2d544951c8b5a746fc755d3e7.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Test the game and make your ideas heard![/b][/h1]
We will be handing out Steam keys to our testers shortly before June 30, so fill in your application before that!

[b]Schedule for Bannermen[/b]
    1.  [url=https://discord.gg/abAvcgP]Alpha[/url] – Apply now 
    2.  [url=https://bannermen.net/#betaSignUp]Beta[/url] – Sign up
    3.  Release: Fall 2018

[h1][b]Alpha units & buildings[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026079/313b694db339b8d5f848987dce76b12c1515008b.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026079/6576e41f983f0a11d5c3559d93081cbb99cec128.jpg[/img]
More units will be available later in development. To get comprehensive feedback we have chose to limit the number of maps and units. The Alpha is an early build that is subject to change. Tell us your ideas now and it might make it into the game.
